policy.summary: Use official standards as primary alignment sources. Use IXL as a staff-only reference for coverage comparison and outbound links. Do not copy proprietary IXL lesson text, skill banks, videos, practice items, explanations, or sequence wholesale into student-facing content.
policy.publishRule: Every student-facing lesson must be written in original Nexus V3 language, pass grading and review, and cite only approved source cards or official standards tags.
ixlAllowedUse: Store public URL metadata for staff review.
Compare broad topic coverage against our original scope sequence.
Link staff to IXL pages as optional external references.
ixlBlockedUse: Copying full skill lists into student-facing content.
Copying IXL lesson explanations, video transcripts, examples, or assessment items.
Presenting IXL sequencing as our curriculum without original redesign and review.
